name: cli
title_zh: 飞书官方 CLI，200+ 命令直连文档、表格、消息
tagline_zh: 不用写代码、不用配 OAuth，终端里直接查消息、改表格、发日程。AI Agent 也能调。
tagline_en: Skip OAuth and coding—query chats, edit sheets, schedule meetings from your terminal. Built for humans and AI.
desc_en: The official Lark/飞书 CLI tool, maintained by the larksuite team — built for humans and AI Agents. Covers core business domains including Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheets, Calendar, Mail, Tasks, Meetings, and more, with 200+ commands and 20+ AI Agent Skills.
why_zh: 官方维护、覆盖 9 大业务域，命令粒度细到单条消息或单元格。对 Agent 而言。
why_en: First-party, covering 9 domains with granular commands down to a message or cell. The only stable channel for agents to drive.
limit_zh: 需要飞书企业版或开发者后台的应用凭证；命令只作用于飞书生态，不碰本地文件。部分写操作受租户权限限制。
limit_en: Requires Lark enterprise app credentials; commands only touch Lark services, not local files. Write ops limited by tenant permissions—out-of-scope.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Official Lark CLI: 200+ commands for Docs, Base, Chat
